## About

POLISHED is a premium branding studio crafting refined visual identities, packaging, and UI/UX for e-commerce skincare brands. Our work emphasizes timeless, "old-money" aesthetics — quiet luxury, minimalist typography, and trustworthy brand systems that convert.

## Services

- E-commerce Branding — full identity systems tailored for online skincare stores.
- UI/UX Design — high-end, conversion-focused storefront and product page design.
- Visual Identity — logos, typography, color systems, and brand guidelines.
- Packaging Design — premium skincare packaging with shelf-ready appeal.
